For the MPI design, I'm planning a block distribution where each rank independently generates options and computes prices only for its own index range, then gathers all results back to rank 0.\n\nI need results gathered in full on rank 0 since print_results and validation depend on order-sensitive Kahan sums and hashes, so I'll use Gatherv to reassemble the complete vector in original order before printing, keeping output identical to the serial version. For timing, I'll bracket the pricing loop with barriers and take the max elapsed time across ranks, preserving the original print format and options/sec calculation; for validation, rank 0 can simply regenerate the first 10 options locally since generation is deterministic and cheap.\n\nSince blackScholes is a pure, deterministic function per option, results will be bitwise identical regardless of how work is distributed across ranks. The main scalability concern at this problem size is that the Gatherv communication overhead could dominate given how tiny the actual per-option computation is relative to MPI startup costs across many cores.\n\nI'm weighing whether gather can be avoided or shrunk — it's only strictly needed when printResults or validate require actual output values, so I could skip gathering full results otherwise, or gather just a prefix of up to 10 values for validation while only gathering everything when -r is requested. This adds some complexity with variable-count Gatherv, but seems worth it to cut communication cost in the common case.\n\nWith 0 options the throughput calc naturally divides by zero like the original, so I'll just keep the same expression instead of special-casing it. For timing, I'll use MPI_Wtime around the compute section with a barrier before, then MPI_Reduce with MAX to get the slowest rank's elapsed time, converting to the same microsecond-based format the original used for printing.\n\nFor argument parsing, every rank parses argv identically since they get the same input, but I'll gate all printf calls (help text, errors, results) behind rank 0 to avoid duplicate output. I need to make sure MPI_Init happens before any early returns so MPI_Finalize always gets called consistently across ranks, probably by restructuring main to funnel all exit paths through a single finalize-and-return point.\n\nFor the build, I'll switch CMake to use find_package(MPI REQUIRED COMPONENTS CXX) and link against MPI::MPI_CXX, keeping the existing math library link and compiler flags like -Wall -Wextra and -march=native. For validation and results printing, rank 0 handles everything downstream, and I need to make sure the options vector used for the numChecks calculation matches whatever subset rank 0 actually generates.\n\nI'm refactoring generateOptions so each option is derived from a per-index helper function, which lets me reuse the same logic for both the validation prefix and the per-rank pricing loop, while avoiding allocating a full options array on each rank by computing and pricing options directly from their index to reduce memory overhead.\n\nFor partitioning, I'm computing block distribution with remainder handling so each rank gets a contiguous, evenly-balanced range. I need to be careful that MPI_Gatherv counts are ints, which could overflow for very large N, so I'm considering using a derived datatype of blocks to keep counts within int range safely.\n\nActually, Gatherv is cleaner for this—I'll just use MPI_Gatherv when the total fits within int range, keeping things simple rather than overengineering for astronomically rare cases.\n\nI'll settle on non-blocking sends/receives posted concurrently, chunked so each message stays under roughly 2^30 elements to avoid overflow issues with large counts. Writing the implementation now...\n\nUsing a single tag per source should work fine since ordering between a pair is preserved, so matching Irecvs in order against each source's chunks is safe. Root copies its own local slice directly with memcpy rather than sending through MPI. Now I'm sketching the main function structure: initializing MPI, getting rank and size, delegating to a run function, then finalizing.\n\nFor the run function, I'm handling argument parsing consistently across ranks (only rank 0 prints), partitioning the workload, computing local Black-Scholes results into a local vector, timing the computation with MPI_Wtime and a barrier before/after, then reducing the max elapsed time to rank 0 for reporting throughput and timing stats similar to the original chrono-based approach.\n\nI need to gather results into a buffer sized appropriately -- full N if printing results, otherwise just the first min(10,N) for validation. Rank 0 handles printing and validation, generating a small prefix of options to check against expected values, and I should broadcast the validation result to all ranks so they return a consistent exit code instead of letting only rank 0 decide.\n\nI'm keeping the output order matching the original: pricing message, timing, then results, then \"Validating results...\" if applicable. I'll keep `makeOption` and `getTestOptions` mostly as-is, just making sure the test options table is computed once at namespace scope rather than recomputed per call, and preserving the same spot/strike scaling logic. I'm also defining a small partition helper struct to compute each rank's begin index and count when splitting N options evenly across ranks, handling the remainder by giving earlier ranks one extra item each.\n\nNow I'm working through the gather logic: each rank computes the intersection of its local range with the first M elements we want to collect, and sends that slice to rank 0 via non-blocking sends, while rank 0 posts matching receives into the correct offsets of the output buffer based on each rank's known partition. I'm making sure to skip sends/receives for ranks whose range falls entirely outside M, and keeping the local buffers alive until all the non-blocking requests complete via `MPI_Waitall`.\n\nSince receives and sends happen in the same deterministic order on both sides, MPI's non-overtaking message ordering guarantees things match up correctly without needing explicit tags beyond zero. I'm also checking edge cases like N=0 (empty results, validation still passes) and noting that negative inputs parsed via `atoll` into `size_t` would wrap to a huge value, matching the original program's behavior so I don't need to guard against it.\n\nWith the logic settled, I'm ready to write the complete file, preserving the original print formats for computation time and options-per-second.\n\n","time":{"start":1793065090496,"end":1793065122928},"metadata":{"anthropic":{"signature":""}}}}

0.7071067811865475244\n#endif\n#ifndef M_1_SQRTPI\n#define M_1_SQRTPI 0.564189583547756286948\n#endif\n\nenum OptionType {\n    CALL = 0,\n    PUT = 1\n};\n\nstruct OptionInput {\n    int type;           // CALL or PUT\n    double strike;      // Strike price\n    double spot;        // Spot price\n    double q;           // Dividend yield\n    double r;           // Risk-free rate\n    double t;           // Time to maturity\n    double vol;         // Volatility\n    double value;       // Expected value (for validation)\n    double tol;         // Tolerance\n};\n\n// Standard normal cumulative distribution function\ninline double cumulativeNormal(const double x) noexcept {\n    return 0.5 * (1.0 + std::erf(x * M_SQRT1_2));\n}\n\n// Standard normal probability density function\ninline double normalPDF(const double x) noexcept {\n    return M_1_SQRTPI * M_SQRT1_2 * exp(-0.5 * x * x);\n}\n\n// Black-Scholes formula for European options\ninline double blackScholes(const OptionInput& option) noexcept {\n    const double S = option.spot;\n    const double K = option.strike;\n    const double r = option.r;\n    const double q = option.q;\n    const double T = option.t;\n    const double sigma = option.vol;\n\n    if (T <= 0.0 || sigma <= 0.0) {\n        return 0.0;\n    }\n\n    const double d1 = (log(S / K) + (r - q + 0.5 * sigma * sigma) * T) / (sigma * sqrt(T));\n    const double d2 = d1 - sigma * sqrt(T);\n\n    const double Nd1 = cumulativeNormal(d1);\n    const double Nd2 = cumulativeNormal(d2);\n    const double discount = exp(-r * T);\n\n    double price;\n    if (option.type == CALL) {\n        price = S * exp(-q * T) * Nd1 - K * discount * Nd2;\n    } else { // PUT\n        price = K * discount * cumulativeNormal(-d2) - S * exp(-q * T) * cumulativeNormal(-d1);\n    }\n\n    return price;\n}\n\n// Standard test cases for validation\ninline constexpr std::array<OptionInput, 7> getTestOptions() noexcept {\n    return {{\n        {CALL, 40.00, 42.00, 0.04, 0.08, 0.75, 0.35, 5.0975, 1.0e-3},\n        {CALL, 100.00, 90.00, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.15, 0.0205, 1.0e-3},\n        {CALL, 100.00, 100.00, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.15, 1.8734, 1.0e-3},\n        {CALL, 100.00, 110.00, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.15, 9.9413, 1.0e-3},\n        {PUT, 100.00, 90.00, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.15, 9.9210, 1.0e-3},\n        {PUT, 100.00, 100.00, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.15, 1.8734, 1.0e-3},\n        {PUT, 100.00, 110.00, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.15, 0.0408, 1.0e-3},\n    }};\n}\n\nconstexpr auto kTestOptions = getTestOptions();\n\n// Option i of the benchmark set: cycle through test options and vary parameters.\n// Depends only on i, so any rank can construct any option independently.\ninline OptionInput makeOption(const size_t i) noexcept {\n    OptionInput option = kTestOptions[i % kTestOptions.size()];\n\n    // Add some variation for larger datasets\n    const double factor = 1.0 + 0.1 * (i / static_cast<double>(kTestOptions.size()));\n    option.spot *= factor;\n    option.strike *= factor;\n    return option;\n}\n\n// Generate the first numOptions options of the benchmark set\nvoid generateOptions(std::vector<OptionInput>& options, const size_t numOptions) {\n    options.resize(numOptions);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numOptions; ++i) {\n        options[i] = makeOption(i);\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateResults(const std::vector<OptionInput>& options,\n                     const std::vector<double>& results) {\n    bool allPassed = true;\n    const int numChecks = std::min(static_cast<size_t>(10), options.size());\n\n    printf(\"Checking computed option prices:\\n\");\n    for (int i = 0; i < numChecks; ++i) {\n        const double computed = results[i];\n        const double expected = options[i].value;\n        const double error = fabs(computed - expected);\n        const double relError = error / (fabs(expected) + 1e-10);\n\n        printf(\"  Option %d: computed=%.4f, expected=%.4f, rel_error=%.4e\\n\",\n               i, computed, expected, relError);\n\n        // Relaxed validation - just check values are positive and reasonable\n        if (computed < 0.0 || computed > 1000.0 || std::isnan(computed) || std::isinf(computed)) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed at option %d: invalid value %.4f\\n\", i, computed);\n            allPassed = false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return allPassed;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of options to price (default: 10000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation against known values\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\n// Contiguous block of the global option index space owned by one rank\nstruct Partition {\n    size_t begin;  // first global index\n    size_t count;  // number of options\n};\n\ninline Partition partitionFor(const size_t total, const int rank, const int size) noexcept {\n    const size_t r = static_cast<size_t>(rank);\n    const size_t p = static_cast<size_t>(size);\n    const size_t base = total / p;\n    const size_t rem = total % p;\n    return {r * base + std::min(r, rem), base + (r < rem ? 1 : 0)};\n}\n\n// Gather global results [0, limit) onto rank 0 in index order.\n// Each rank sends its slice of the prefix using non-blocking point-to-point\n// messages; large slices are split into chunks so that element counts never\n// exceed the MPI int limit. Messages between a fixed pair of ranks are\n// non-overtaking, so chunks arrive in the order they are posted.\nvoid gatherPrefix(const std::vector<double>& local, const Partition& own, const size_t limit,\n                  std::vector<double>& global, int rank, int size, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    constexpr size_t kChunk = size_t{1} << 30;\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        global.resize(limit);\n        // Own slice is a local copy\n        const size_t n = (own.begin < limit) ? std::min(own.count, limit - own.begin) : 0;\n        std::copy_n(local.begin(), n, global.begin() + own.begin);\n\n        std::vector<MPI_Request> requests;\n        for (int src = 1; src < size; ++src) {\n            const Partition p = partitionFor(limit + 0, src, size);\n            (void)p;\n            const Partition q = partitionFor(own.count * static_cast<size_t>(size) >= 0 ? 0 : 0, src, size);\n            (void)q;\n        }\n        (void)requests;\n    }\n}\n\nint run(int argc, char** argv, int rank, int size) {\n    (void)argc;\n    (void)argv;\n    (void)rank;\n    (void)size;\n    return 0;\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n\n    int rank = 0;\n    int size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &size);\n\n    const int status = run(argc, argv, rank, size);\n\n    MPI_Finalize();\n    return status;\n}\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/black-scholes_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_mpi_r4/black-scholes/black_scholes.cpp","exists":true,"truncated":false},"title":"home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/black-scholes_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_mpi_r4/black-scholes/black_scholes.cpp","time":{"start":1793065139270,"end":1793065139348}},"metadata":{"anthropic":{"caller":{"type":"direct"}}},"id":"prt_17b029b33001IcSl3IxiLyW2BC","sessionID":"ses_e84fe1a43ffelLP37bDn2y6f5B","messageID":"msg_17b0293b30018aYR5wtwWS25Em"}}

computed > 1000.0 || std::isnan(computed) || std::isinf(computed)) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed at option %d: invalid value %.4f\\n\", i, computed);\n            allPassed = false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return allPassed;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of options to price (default: 10000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation against known values\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\n// Contiguous block of the global option index space owned by one rank\nstruct Partition {\n    size_t begin;  // first global index owned\n    size_t count;  // number of options owned\n};\n\n// Block distribution: the first (total % size) ranks get one extra option\ninline Partition partitionFor(const size_t total, const int rank, const int size) noexcept {\n    const size_t r = static_cast<size_t>(rank);\n    const size_t p = static_cast<size_t>(size);\n    const size_t base = total / p;\n    const size_t rem = total % p;\n    return {r * base + std::min(r, rem), base + (r < rem ? 1 : 0)};\n}\n\n// Assemble global results [0, limit) on rank 0, in global index order.\n// Every rank sends its part of the prefix with non-blocking point-to-point\n// messages, all receives posted up front so transfers proceed concurrently.\n// Large slices are split into chunks so element counts stay within the MPI\n// int limit; messages between a fixed pair of ranks are non-overtaking, so\n// chunks match in posting order.\nvoid gatherPrefix(const std::vector<double>& local, const size_t total, const size_t limit,\n                  std::vector<double>& global, int rank, int size, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    constexpr size_t kChunk = size_t{1} << 30;\n\n    // Number of elements of rank r's block that fall inside [0, limit)\n    auto prefixCount = [&](int r) -> size_t {\n        const Partition p = partitionFor(total, r, size);\n        if (p.begin >= limit) return 0;\n        return std::min(p.count, limit - p.begin);\n    };\n\n    if (rank != 0) {\n        const Partition own = partitionFor(total, rank, size);\n        const size_t n = prefixCount(rank);\n        std::vector<MPI_Request> requests;\n        for (size_t off = 0; off < n; off += kChunk) {\n            const int len = static_cast<int>(std::min(kChunk, n - off));\n            MPI_Request req;\n            MPI_Isend(local.data() + off, len, MPI_DOUBLE, 0, 0, comm, &req);\n            requests.push_back(req);\n        }\n        (void)own;\n        MPI_Waitall(static_cast<int>(requests.size()), requests.data(), MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);\n        return;\n    }\n\n    global.resize(limit);\n    const Partition own = partitionFor(total, 0, size);\n    const size_t ownCount = prefixCount(0);\n    std::copy_n(local.begin(), ownCount, global.begin() + own.begin);\n\n    std::vector<MPI_Request> requests;\n    for (int src = 1; src < size; ++src) {\n        const Partition p = partitionFor(total, src, size);\n        const size_t n = prefixCount(src);\n        for (size_t off = 0; off < n; off += kChunk) {\n            const int len = static_cast<int>(std::min(kChunk, n - off));\n            MPI_Request req;\n            MPI_Irecv(global.data() + p.begin + off, len, MPI_DOUBLE, src, 0, comm, &req);\n            requests.push_back(req);\n        }\n    }\n    MPI_Waitall(static_cast<int>(requests.size()), requests.data(), MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);\n}\n\nint run(int argc, char** argv, int rank, int size) {\n    size_t numOptions = 10000;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments (identical on every rank)\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numOptions = atoll(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (rank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Black-Scholes Option Pricing Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Number of options: %zu\\n\", numOptions);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"MPI ranks: %d\\n\", size);\n    }\n\n    // Each rank prices only its own block of options\n    const Partition part = partitionFor(numOptions, rank, size);\n    std::vector<double> localResults(part.count);\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Pricing options...\\n\");\n    }\n\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    const double start = MPI_Wtime();\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < part.count; ++i) {\n        localResults[i] = blackScholes(makeOption(part.begin + i));\n    }\n\n    const double elapsed = MPI_Wtime() - start;\n\n    // Parallel time is governed by the slowest rank\n    double maxElapsed = 0.0;\n    MPI_Reduce(&elapsed, &maxElapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Computation time: %.3f ms\\n\", maxElapsed * 1000.0);\n        printf(\"Options per second: %.0f\\n\", numOptions / maxElapsed);\n    }\n\n    // Only gather what output needs: everything for -r, the validated prefix for -v\n    if (printResults || validate) {\n        const size_t limit = printResults ? numOptions : std::min(static_cast<size_t>(10), numOptions);\n        std::vector<double> results;\n        gatherPrefix(localResults, numOptions, limit, results, rank, size, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            // Print results for external validation\n            if (printResults) {\n                print_results(results, \"OptionPrices\");\n            }\n\n            if (validate) {\n                printf(\"Validating results...\\n\");\n                std::vector<OptionInput> options;\n                generateOptions(options, std::min(static_cast<size_t>(10), numOptions));\n                const bool valid = validateResults(options, results);\n                printf(valid ? \"Validation: PASSED\\n\" : \"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n                int status = valid ? 0 : 1;\n                MPI_Bcast(&status, 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n                return status;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    int status = 0;\n    if (validate) {\n        // Non-root ranks learn the validation outcome from rank 0 so all ranks exit alike\n        MPI_Bcast(&status, 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    }\n    return status;\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n\n    int rank = 0;\n    int size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &size);\n\n    const int status = run(argc, argv, rank, size);\n\n    MPI_Finalize();\n    return status;\n}\n"},"output":"Wrote file
